            }, 5000);
          },
          stopAutoWritePolling() { if (this.autoWriteIntervalId) clearInterval(this.autoWriteIntervalId); },
            addPendingAction(actionPayload) {
    // 核心修复：对 mount_mag 动作进行特殊处理，确保它只操作单个物品
    if (actionPayload.action === 'mount_mag') {
        // 强制数量为1，并确保它是一个独立的动作，不与其他堆叠动作合并
        actionPayload.quantity = 1;
        this.pendingActions.push(actionPayload);
    } else {
        // 保持原有的堆叠逻辑
        const isStackable = ['use', 'deposit', 'withdraw', 'discard'].includes(actionPayload.action);
        const existingAction = isStackable ? this.pendingActions.find(
            a => a.action === actionPayload.action && a.itemName === actionPayload.itemName
        ) : null;

        if (existingAction) {
            existingAction.quantity += actionPayload.quantity;
        } else {
            this.pendingActions.push(actionPayload);
        }
    }

    this.optimisticState = this.calculateOptimisticUpdate();
    if (this.optimisticState) {
        this.renderUI(this.optimisticState);
        this.rerenderActiveModal();
        this.savePendingActions();
        this.renderQuickCommands();
        const actionTextMap = { 'use': '使用', 'equip': '装备', 'unequip': '卸下', 'discard': '丢弃', 'deposit': `存入`, 'withdraw': `取出`, 'equip_from_safehouse': '装备', load_mag: '装填', unload_mag: '卸载', mount_mag: '装载' };
        this.showTemporaryMessage(`指令已入队: ${actionTextMap[actionPayload.action]} ${actionPayload.itemName || ''}`);
    } else {
        // 如果乐观更新失败，需要回滚刚才的动作
        // 这是一个简化的回滚，对于复杂情况可能需要更精细的逻辑
        const lastAction = this.pendingActions[this.pendingActions.length - 1];
        if (lastAction.action === actionPayload.action && lastAction.itemName === actionPayload.itemName) {
            if (lastAction.quantity > actionPayload.quantity) {
                lastAction.quantity -= actionPayload.quantity;
            } else {
                this.pendingActions.pop();
            }
        }
    }
},
            calculateOptimisticUpdate() {
    if (!this.currentMvuState) return null;
    const tempState = _.cloneDeep(this.currentMvuState);

    for (const action of this.pendingActions) {
        let successThisAction = true;
        const { itemName, quantity, targetSlot, ammoBlocks } = action;
        const inventoryKey = '物品列表';
        const safehouseKey = '安全屋仓库';
        
        // 辅助函数：剥离物品名称中的状态前缀，如 "[30/45] "
        const getBaseItemName = (name) => {
            if (typeof name !== 'string') return '';
            return name.replace(/^\[\d+\/\d+\]\s*/, '');
        };
        
        // 辅助函数：根据完整名称查找物品
        const findItemByFullName = (list, fullName) => {
            return _.findIndex(list, { '名称': fullName });
        };
        
        // 辅助函数：根据基础名称查找物品（用于堆叠）
        const findStackableItemByBaseName = (list, baseName) => {
            return _.findIndex(list, (item) => getBaseItemName(item.名称) === baseName && !item.名称.match(/^\[\d+\/\d+\]\s*/));
        };

        switch (action.action) {
            // ... (use, discard, deposit, withdraw, equip, unequip, mount_mag 的 case 保持不变) ...
            case 'use':
            case 'discard': {
                const list = this._getListReference(tempState, inventoryKey);
                if (!list) { successThisAction = false; break; }
                const itemIndex = findItemByFullName(list, itemName);
                if (itemIndex > -1 && list[itemIndex].数量 >= quantity) {
                    list[itemIndex].数量 -= quantity;
                    if (list[itemIndex].数量 <= 0) list.splice(itemIndex, 1);
                } else { successThisAction = false; }
                break;
            }
            case 'deposit': {
                const inventory = this._getListReference(tempState, inventoryKey);
                if (!inventory) { successThisAction = false; break; }
                const itemIndex = findItemByFullName(inventory, itemName);
                if (itemIndex > -1 && inventory[itemIndex].数量 >= quantity) {
                    this.moveItem(tempState, inventoryKey, safehouseKey, itemIndex, quantity);
                } else { successThisAction = false; }
                break;
            }
            case 'withdraw': {
                const safehouse = this._getListReference(tempState, safehouseKey);
                if (!safehouse) { successThisAction = false; break; }
                const itemIndex = findItemByFullName(safehouse, itemName);
                if (itemIndex > -1 && safehouse[itemIndex].数量 >= quantity) {
                    this.moveItem(tempState, safehouseKey, inventoryKey, itemIndex, quantity);
                } else { successThisAction = false; }
                break;
            }
            case 'equip':
            case 'equip_from_safehouse': {
                const fromKey = action.action === 'equip' ? inventoryKey : safehouseKey;
                const fromList = this._getListReference(tempState, fromKey);
                const toInventory = this._getListReference(tempState, inventoryKey);
                if (!fromList || !toInventory) { successThisAction = false; break; }
                const itemIndex = findItemByFullName(fromList, itemName);
                if (itemIndex > -1) {
                    const itemToEquip = _.cloneDeep(fromList[itemIndex]);
                    itemToEquip.数量 = 1;
                    if (targetSlot) {
                        const currentItem = this.SafeGetValue(tempState.stat_data, targetSlot);
                        if (currentItem) {
                            const baseReturnName = getBaseItemName(currentItem.名称);
                            const existingReturnItemStack = findStackableItemByBaseName(toInventory, baseReturnName);
                            if (existingReturnItemStack > -1) {
                                toInventory[existingReturnItemStack].数量 += 1;
                            } else {
                                toInventory.push(currentItem);
                            }
                        }
                        _.set(tempState.stat_data, targetSlot, [itemToEquip, tempState.stat_data[targetSlot][1]]);
                        fromList[itemIndex].数量 -= 1;
                        if (fromList[itemIndex].数量 <= 0) fromList.splice(itemIndex, 1);
                    } else {
                        successThisAction = false;
                    }
                } else { successThisAction = false; }
                break;
            }
            case 'unequip': {
                const inventory = this._getListReference(tempState, inventoryKey);
                const slots = Object.values(this.getEquipmentSlotMap());
                const slot = slots.find(s => this.SafeGetValue(tempState.stat_data, s.key)?.名称 === itemName);
                if (slot && inventory) {
                    const itemToUnequip = this.SafeGetValue(tempState.stat_data, slot.key);
                    const baseItemName = getBaseItemName(itemToUnequip.名称);
                    const existingItemStack = findStackableItemByBaseName(inventory, baseItemName);

                    if (existingItemStack > -1) {
                        inventory[existingItemStack].数量 += 1;
                    } else {
                        inventory.push(itemToUnequip);
                    }
                    _.set(tempState.stat_data, slot.key, [null, tempState.stat_data[slot.key][1]]);
                } else {
                    successThisAction = false;
                }
                break;
            }
            case 'mount_mag': {
                const inventory = this._getListReference(tempState, inventoryKey);
                const magIndex = findItemByFullName(inventory, itemName);
                
                if (magIndex > -1) {
                    const magStack = inventory[magIndex];
                    const mainWeapon = this.SafeGetValue(tempState.stat_data, '已装备主武器');
                    const secondaryWeapon = this.SafeGetValue(tempState.stat_data, '已装备副武器');
                    let targetWeaponSlotKey = null;

                    if (mainWeapon && mainWeapon.属性?.适用口径 === magStack.属性?.口径) {
                        targetWeaponSlotKey = '已装备主武器弹匣';
                    } else if (secondaryWeapon && secondaryWeapon.属性?.适用口径 === magStack.属性?.口径) {
                        targetWeaponSlotKey = '已装备副武器弹匣';
                    }

                    if (targetWeaponSlotKey) {
                        const currentMag = this.SafeGetValue(tempState.stat_data, targetWeaponSlotKey);
                        if (currentMag) {
                            const baseCurrentMagName = getBaseItemName(currentMag.名称);
                            const existingMagStackIndex = findStackableItemByBaseName(inventory, baseCurrentMagName);
                            if (existingMagStackIndex > -1) {
                                inventory[existingMagStackIndex].数量 += 1;
                            } else {
                                inventory.push(currentMag);
                            }
                        }
                        
                        const magToMount = _.cloneDeep(magStack);
                        magToMount.数量 = 1;
                        _.set(tempState.stat_data, targetWeaponSlotKey, [magToMount, tempState.stat_data[targetWeaponSlotKey][1]]);
                        
                        magStack.数量 -= 1;
                        if (magStack.数量 <= 0) {
                            inventory.splice(magIndex, 1);
                        }
                    } else {
                        successThisAction = false;
                    }
                } else {
                    successThisAction = false;
                }
                break;
            }

            // --- 核心修复：重写 load_mag 逻辑以实现状态分化 ---
            case 'load_mag': {
                const inventory = this._getListReference(tempState, inventoryKey);
                const magIndex = findItemByFullName(inventory, itemName);

                if (magIndex > -1) {
                    const magStack = inventory[magIndex];
                    let totalAmmoLoaded = 0;

                    // 1. 从库存扣除弹药
                    (ammoBlocks || []).forEach(blockToLoad => {
                        if (!successThisAction) return;
                        const ammoIndex = findItemByFullName(inventory, blockToLoad.弹药名称);
                        if (ammoIndex > -1 && inventory[ammoIndex].数量 >= blockToLoad.数量) {
                            inventory[ammoIndex].数量 -= blockToLoad.数量;
                            if (inventory[ammoIndex].数量 <= 0) inventory.splice(ammoIndex, 1);
                            totalAmmoLoaded += blockToLoad.数量;
                        } else {
                            successThisAction = false; // 库存不足
                        }
                    });

                    if (successThisAction && totalAmmoLoaded > 0) {
                        // 2. 创建一个新的、已装填的弹匣对象
                        const loadedMag = _.cloneDeep(magStack);
                        loadedMag.数量 = 1; // 新物品数量为1
                        if (!loadedMag.属性.装载弹药) loadedMag.属性.装载弹药 = [];
                        loadedMag.属性.装载弹药.push(...ammoBlocks);
                        
                        // 3. 更新新弹匣的名称以反映状态
                        const currentAmmoCount = loadedMag.属性.装载弹药.reduce((sum, block) => sum + (block.数量 || 0), 0);
                        const maxCapacity = loadedMag.属性.最大弹量;
                        const baseName = getBaseItemName(loadedMag.名称);
                        loadedMag.名称 = `[${currentAmmoCount}/${maxCapacity}] ${baseName}`;
                        
                        // 4. 将新弹匣添加到库存
                        inventory.push(loadedMag);

                        // 5. 更新原弹匣堆叠的数量
                        magStack.数量 -= 1;
                        if (magStack.数量 <= 0) {
                            // 因为我们是在遍历时修改数组，所以要安全地移除
                            // magIndex 在这里可能已经因为弹药的移除而不准确了，需要重新查找
                            const originalMagIndex = findItemByFullName(inventory, itemName);
                            if (originalMagIndex > -1) {
                                inventory.splice(originalMagIndex, 1);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else { 
                    successThisAction = false; 
                }
                break;
            }
            case 'unload_mag': {
                const inventory = this._getListReference(tempState, inventoryKey);
                if (!inventory) { successThisAction = false; break; }
                const magIndex = findItemByFullName(inventory, itemName);
                if (magIndex > -1 && inventory[magIndex].属性?.装载弹药?.length > 0) {
                    const mag = inventory[magIndex];
                    (mag.属性.装载弹药 || []).forEach(ammoBlock => {
                        const existingAmmo = findItemByFullName(inventory, ammoBlock.弹药名称);
                        if (existingAmmo > -1) {
                            inventory[existingAmmo].数量 += ammoBlock.数量;
                        } else {
                           // 这个逻辑可能不完美，因为它无法知道弹药的完整属性
                           const baseAmmoName = getBaseItemName(ammoBlock.弹药名称);
                           const sourceAmmoItem = this.findItemInState(baseAmmoName, 'player') || this.findItemInState(baseAmmoName, 'safehouse');
                           const newItem = sourceAmmoItem ? _.cloneDeep(sourceAmmoItem) : { 标签:['弹药'], 描述: '卸下的弹药。' };
                           newItem.名称 = ammoBlock.弹药名称;
                           newItem.数量 = ammoBlock.数量;
                           inventory.push(newItem);
                        }
                    });
                    
                    // 将卸载后的弹匣变回普通的、未装填的弹匣堆叠
                    const baseMagName = getBaseItemName(mag.名称);
                    const existingEmptyMagStack = findStackableItemByBaseName(inventory, baseMagName);
                    if (existingEmptyMagStack > -1) {
                        inventory[existingEmptyMagStack].数量 += 1;
                    } else {
                        // 如果没有空的堆叠，就创建一个
                        const newEmptyMag = _.cloneDeep(mag);
                        newEmptyMag.名称 = baseMagName;
                        newEmptyMag.数量 = 1;
                        newEmptyMag.属性.装载弹药 = [];
                        inventory.push(newEmptyMag);
                    }
                    inventory.splice(magIndex, 1); // 移除那个已装填的弹匣
                } else {
                    successThisAction = false;
                }
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!successThisAction) {
            this.showTemporaryMessage('乐观更新失败，操作可能无效。');
            return null;
        }
    }
    this.recalculateWeightAndVolume(tempState);
    return tempState;
},
recalculateWeightAndVolume(state) {
    const allEquippedItems = Object.values(this.getEquipmentSlotMap())
        .map(slot => this.SafeGetValue(state.stat_data, slot.key))
        .filter(item => item && typeof item === 'object');
    const inventoryItems = this.SafeGetValue(state.stat_data, '物品列表', []);
    
    // 核心修复：AI提供的`重量`字段已经是该物品堆叠的总重量，无需再乘以数量。
    const totalWeight = _.sumBy([...allEquippedItems, ...inventoryItems], item => {
        // 直接使用 `item.重量` 作为该物品堆叠的总重量。
        return parseFloat(item.重量) || 0;
    });

    _.set(state.stat_data, '当前负重', [parseFloat(totalWeight.toFixed(2)), "当前总负重"]);
},

                if (existingTargetItem) {

            },

          showInventoryTooltip(element, event) {
                clearTimeout(this.tooltipTimeoutId);
                clearTimeout(this.tooltipHideTimeoutId);
                const tooltip = document.getElementById('equipment-tooltip');
                const itemDataString = element.dataset.itemDetails;
                if (!tooltip || !itemDataString) return;
                this.tooltipTimeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                    try {
                        const item = JSON.parse(itemDataString);
                        tooltip.innerHTML = this.renderTooltipContent(item);
                        tooltip.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                        tooltip.style.display = 'block';
                        const tooltipRect = tooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
                        const containerRect = this.rootContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
                        const elementRect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
                        const margin = 10;
                        let idealTop = elementRect.bottom - containerRect.top + margin;
                        let idealLeft = elementRect.left - containerRect.left + (elementRect.width / 2);
                        if (idealTop + tooltipRect.height + margin > containerRect.height) {
                            let topPosition = elementRect.top - containerRect.top - tooltipRect.height - margin;
                            if (topPosition < margin) topPosition = margin;
                            idealTop = topPosition;
                        }
                        const visualLeftEdge = idealLeft - (tooltipRect.width / 2);
                        const visualRightEdge = idealLeft + (tooltipRect.width / 2);
                        if (visualRightEdge + margin > containerRect.width) idealLeft -= (visualRightEdge + margin - containerRect.width);
                        if (visualLeftEdge - margin < 0) idealLeft += (margin - visualLeftEdge);
                        tooltip.style.left = `${idealLeft}px`;
                        tooltip.style.top = `${idealTop}px`;
                        tooltip.style.transform = `translateX(-50%)`;
                        tooltip.style.visibility = 'visible';
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.error('解析物品提示框数据失败:', e);
                        tooltip.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                }, 200);

            renderItemDetailsForTooltip(item) {
    if (!item) return '';
    let details = '<div class="tooltip-attributes">';
    const renderP = (label, value) => (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') ? `<p><strong>${label}:</strong> <span>${value}</span></p>` : '';
    if (item.状态?.状态类型 === '耐久度') details += renderP('状态', `${item.状态.当前}/${item.状态.最大}`);
    else if (item.状态?.状态类型 === '保质期') details += renderP('过期于', item.状态.过期日);
    const props = item.属性 || {};
    const tags = item.标签 || [];
    if (props.恢复的能量值) details += renderP('能量恢复', props.恢复的能量值);
    if (props.恢复的水分值) details += renderP('水分恢复', props.恢复的水分值);
    if (props.效果) details += renderP('效果', props.效果);
    if (tags.includes('近战')) {
        details += renderP('伤害', props.伤害);
        details += renderP('类型', props.类型);
        details += renderP('穿透', props.穿透);
        details += renderP('冲击力', props.冲击力);
    }
    if (tags.includes('武器') && !tags.includes('近战')) {
        details += renderP('口径', props.适用口径);
        details += renderP('开火模式', Array.isArray(props.射击模式) ? props.射击模式.join('/') : props.射击模式);
        details += renderP('射程', `${props.有效射程}米`);
        details += renderP('膛内', (props.枪膛内弹药 && props.枪膛内弹药.名称) ? props.枪膛内弹药.名称 : '空');
    }
    if (tags.includes('弹匣')) {
        details += renderP('口径', props.口径);
        const loadedAmmo = Array.isArray(props.装载弹药) ? props.装载弹药 : [];
        const currentAmmo = loadedAmmo.reduce((sum, block) => sum + (block.数量 || 0), 0);
        details += renderP('容量', `${currentAmmo}/${props.最大弹量}`);
    }
    if (tags.includes('弹药')) {
        details += renderP('基础伤害', props.基础伤害);
        details += renderP('穿透等级', props.穿透等级);
        details += renderP('额外效果', props.额外效果);
    }
    if (tags.includes('防弹衣') || tags.includes('头部装备') || tags.includes('面部装备')) {
        details += renderP('护甲等级', props.AC);
        details += renderP('减伤率', props.DR);
        details += renderP('防护区域', Array.isArray(props.防护区) ? props.防护区.join(', ') : props.防护区);
    }
    details += '</div>';
    if (Array.isArray(props.装载弹药) && props.装载弹药.length > 0) {
        details += `<div class="tooltip-section-title" style="margin-top:10px;">已装填弹药</div>
                    <ul class="tooltip-ammo-list">
                    ${props.装载弹药.map(ammo => `<li><strong>${ammo.弹药名称 || '未知弹药'}</strong> x ${ammo.数量}</li>`).join('')}
                    </ul>`;
    } else if(tags.includes('弹匣')) {
        details += `<div class="tooltip-section-title" style="margin-top:10px; color: var(--pip-boy-green-dim);">弹匣为空</div>`;
    }
    
    // ▼▼▼ 核心修复与优化部分 ▼▼▼
    if (Array.isArray(props.已安装配件及效果) && props.已安装配件及效果.length > 0) {
        details += `<div class="tooltip-section-title" style="margin-top:10px;">已安装配件</div>
                   <ul class="tooltip-accessories-list">
                   ${props.已安装配件及效果.map(acc => {
                       // 优先使用 '名称'，如果不存在，则退回到 '配件名'
                       const accessoryName = acc.名称 || acc.配件名;
                       const effect = acc.效果 || '未知效果';
                       
                       // 如果有配件名，则显示 "名称: 效果"
                       if (accessoryName) {
                           return `<li><strong>${accessoryName}:</strong> ${effect}</li>`;
                       }
                       // 如果只有效果，则直接显示效果
                       return `<li>${effect}</li>`;
                   }).join('')}
                   </ul>`;
    }
                return details;

async promptForCustomQuantity(itemName, maxQuantity, baseAction) {
    return new Promise(resolve => {

        const actionLabels = {
            'use': '使用', 'discard': '丢弃', 'deposit': '存入', 'withdraw': '取出'
        };
        const actionLabel = actionLabels[baseAction] || '操作';

        modal.innerHTML = `
            <div class="modal-content" style="width: auto; max-width: 400px; height: auto;">
              <div class="modal-header"><h2 class="modal-title">输入数量</h2></div>
              <div class="modal-body" style="padding: 20px; text-align: center;">

                       style="width: 100%; text-align: center; font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 20px;">
                   <button id="quantity-cancel" class="interaction-btn">取消</button>
                   <button id="quantity-confirm" class="interaction-btn primary-btn">确认</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        this.rootContainer.appendChild(modal);

        const input = modal.querySelector('#custom-quantity-input');
        const confirmBtn = modal.querySelector('#quantity-confirm');
        const cancelBtn = modal.querySelector('#quantity-cancel');

        const cleanupAndResolve = (value) => {
            modal.remove();
            resolve(value);
        };

        confirmBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const quantity = parseInt(input.value, 10);
            if (!isNaN(quantity) && quantity > 0 && quantity <= maxQuantity) {
                cleanupAndResolve(quantity);
            } else {
                this.showTemporaryMessage(`请输入一个1到${maxQuantity}之间的有效数量。`, 2500);
            }
        });

        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => cleanupAndResolve(null));
        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') confirmBtn.click();
            if (e.key === 'Escape') cancelBtn.click();
        });

        setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 100);
    });
},

            async handleItemInteraction(event) {
    const button = event.target.closest('button[data-action]');
    if (!button || button.disabled) return;
    const action = button.dataset.action;
    const itemName = button.dataset.itemName;

    if (action === 'custom_quantity') {
        const baseAction = button.dataset.baseAction;
        const itemLocation = (baseAction === 'withdraw' || baseAction === 'equip_from_safehouse') ? 'safehouse' : 'player';
        const item = this.findItemInState(itemName, itemLocation);
        if (!item) return;
        
        // --- 核心修复：调用新的自定义UI代替 prompt ---
        const customQuantity = await this.promptForCustomQuantity(itemName, item.数量, baseAction);
        
        if (customQuantity !== null) {
            this.addPendingAction({ action: baseAction, itemName, quantity: customQuantity });
        }
    } else if (action === 'equip' || action === 'equip_from_safehouse') {
        const itemLocation = action === 'equip' ? 'player' : 'safehouse';
        const item = this.findItemInState(itemName, itemLocation);
        if (!item) return;
        const validSlots = this.getValidSlotsForItem(item);
        if (validSlots.length === 1) {
            this.addPendingAction({ action, itemName, quantity: 1, targetSlot: validSlots[0].key });
        } else if (validSlots.length > 1) {
            const slotChoice = await this.promptForSlotChoice(itemName, validSlots);
            if(slotChoice) {
                this.addPendingAction({ action, itemName, quantity: 1, targetSlot: slotChoice });
            }
        } else {
            this.showTemporaryMessage(`[${itemName}]没有可用的装备槽位。`);
        }
    } else if (action === 'load_mag') {
        const mag = this.findItemInState(itemName, 'player');
        if(mag) await this.showLoadMagInterface(mag);
    }
    else {
        const quantity = parseInt(button.dataset.quantity, 10) || 1;
        this.addPendingAction({ action, itemName, quantity });
    }
},

    background: rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.05);

}

}

    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 13px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 15px;
    align-items: center;
}

          _getDisplayText(aiResponse) {
            try {
              if (!aiResponse || typeof aiResponse !== 'string') return '';
              const gameText = this._extractLastTagContent('gametxt', aiResponse);
              if (gameText !== null && gameText.trim() !== '') {
                  return gameText.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, '').trim();
              }
              let cleanedText = aiResponse;
              const tagsToRemove = ['生存日志', '行动档案', '动态世界', 'UpdateVariable', '行动选项', 'action', '地图', 'thinking', '角色提取', 'Analysis'];
              tagsToRemove.forEach(tag => {
                  const regexWithContent = new RegExp(`<${tag}(?:\\s+[^>]*?)?>[\\s\\S]*?<\\/${tag}>`, 'gi');
                  cleanedText = cleanedText.replace(regexWithContent, '');
              });
              return cleanedText.trim();
            } catch (e) {
              console.error("解析显示文本时出错:", e, "原始输入:", aiResponse);
              return "[解析失败]";
            }
          },
           _extractLastTagContent(tagName, text, ignoreCase = false) {
               if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return null;

               const closeTag = `</${tagName}>`;
               const textToSearch = ignoreCase ? text.toLowerCase() : text;
               const closeTagToSearch = ignoreCase ? closeTag.toLowerCase() : closeTag;

               // 1. 找到最后一个闭合标签的位置
               const lastCloseIndex = textToSearch.lastIndexOf(closeTagToSearch);
               if (lastCloseIndex === -1) {
                   return null; // 如果连闭合标签都找不到，直接返回
               }

               // 2. 在最后一个闭合标签之前的所有文本中，寻找开标签
               const textBeforeClose = text.substring(0, lastCloseIndex);
               
               // 3. 使用正则表达式来查找所有开标签（因为开标签可能带属性）
               const openTagRegex = new RegExp(`<${tagName}(?:\\s+[^>]*?)?>`, ignoreCase ? 'gi' : 'g');
               const openMatches = [...textBeforeClose.matchAll(openTagRegex)];

               if (openMatches.length === 0) {
                   return null; // 在最后一个闭合标签前找不到任何开标签
               }

               // 4. 取最后一个匹配到的开标签
               const lastOpenMatch = openMatches[openMatches.length - 1];
               
               // 5. 计算内容的起始位置（在最后一个开标签的末尾）
               const contentStartIndex = lastOpenMatch.index + lastOpenMatch[0].length;
               
               // 6. 提取并返回从内容起始位置到最后一个闭合标签起始位置之间的文本
               return text.substring(contentStartIndex, lastCloseIndex).trim();
           },

_extractGreedyTagContent(tagName, text) {
    if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return null;

    // 使用正则表达式来找到第一个开标签，这样可以处理属性并忽略大小写
    const openRegex = new RegExp(`<${tagName}(?:\\s+[^>]*?)?>`, 'i');
    const openMatch = text.match(openRegex);

    if (!openMatch || openMatch.index === undefined) {
        return null; // 没有找到开标签
    }

    // 使用 lastIndexOf 来找到最后一个闭标签，这比正则更高效
    const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
    const closeTag = `</${tagName.toLowerCase()}>`;
    const lastCloseIndex = lowerText.lastIndexOf(closeTag);

    if (lastCloseIndex === -1 || lastCloseIndex < openMatch.index) {
        return null; // 没有找到闭标签，或者闭标签在开标签前面
    }

    // 计算内容的起始位置（在第一个开标签之后）
    const contentStartIndex = openMatch.index + openMatch[0].length;
    // 内容的结束位置（在最后一个闭标签之前）
    const contentEndIndex = lastCloseIndex;

    return text.substring(contentStartIndex, contentEndIndex).trim();
},

            async showLoadMagInterface(magazine) {
    const state = this._getDisplayState();
    const inventory = this._getListReference(state, '物品列表');
    const magazineCaliber = magazine.属性?.口径?.toLowerCase();

    if (!magazineCaliber) {
        this.showTemporaryMessage('弹匣信息错误，无法确定口径。');
        return;
    }

    const compatibleAmmo = inventory.filter(item => {
        if (!item || !Array.isArray(item.标签) || !item.标签.includes('弹药')) return false;
        const itemNameLower = item.名称?.toLowerCase();
        if (itemNameLower && itemNameLower.includes(magazineCaliber)) return true;
        const ammoCaliber = item.属性?.适用口径?.toLowerCase();
        if (ammoCaliber && ammoCaliber === magazineCaliber) return true;
        return false;
    });

    if (compatibleAmmo.length === 0) {
        this.showTemporaryMessage(`未找到[${magazine.名称}]的兼容弹药 (${magazine.属性?.口径})。`);
        return;
    }

    // --- 核心修复：计算弹匣剩余容量 ---
    const maxCapacity = parseInt(magazine.属性?.最大弹量, 10) || 0;
    const loadedAmmo = Array.isArray(magazine.属性?.装载弹药) ? magazine.属性.装载弹药 : [];
    const currentAmmoCount = loadedAmmo.reduce((sum, block) => sum + (block.数量 || 0), 0);
    let remainingCapacity = maxCapacity - currentAmmoCount;

    if (remainingCapacity <= 0) {
        this.showTemporaryMessage('弹匣已满，无需装填。');
        return;
    }

    return new Promise(resolve => {
        const modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.className = 'modal-overlay';
        modal.style.cssText = 'display: flex; z-index: 12001;';

        let ammoOptionsHtml = compatibleAmmo.map(ammo => `
            <div class="load-ammo-option" style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;">

            </div>
        `).join('');

        modal.innerHTML = `
            <div class="modal-content" style="width: 500px; height: auto;">
              <div class="modal-header" style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">

                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px;">
                   <button id="load-mag-cancel" class="interaction-btn btn-danger">取消</button>
                   <button id="load-mag-confirm" class="interaction-btn primary-btn">装填</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        this.rootContainer.appendChild(modal);

        const ammoInputs = modal.querySelectorAll('.ammo-input');
        const remainingDisplay = modal.querySelector('#remaining-capacity-display');
        const capacityDisplay = modal.querySelector('#mag-capacity-display');

        ammoInputs.forEach(input => {
            input.addEventListener('input', () => {
                let totalToLoad = 0;
                ammoInputs.forEach(i => {
                    totalToLoad += parseInt(i.value, 10) || 0;
                });

                if (totalToLoad > remainingCapacity) {
                    const overflow = totalToLoad - remainingCapacity;
                    const currentValue = parseInt(input.value, 10) || 0;
                    input.value = Math.max(0, currentValue - overflow);
                    this.showTemporaryMessage('超出弹匣容量上限！', 1500);
                }
            });
        });

            const ammoToLoad = [];

                });
            }
            modal.remove();
            resolve();
        });

        modal.querySelector('#load-mag-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => {
            modal.remove();
            resolve();
        });
    });

        this.saveInputToHistory(userMessage);
    }
    if (!userMessage && this.pendingActions.length === 0) {
        this.isBusy = false;
        this.showTemporaryMessage("请输入行动或添加指令。");
        return;
    }
    this.showWaitingMessage();
    const finalPrompt = this.formatActionsForAI(userMessage);

    // 如果不是通过按钮点击触发的，才清空输入框
    if (typeof userMessageOverride !== 'string' && input) {
        input.value = '';
    }

    this.pendingActions = [];
    this.savePendingActions();
    this.renderQuickCommands();
    try {
        if (this.isStreamingEnabled) {
             await TavernHelper.generate({
                injects: [{ role: 'user', content: finalPrompt, position: 'in_chat', depth: 0, should_scan: true }],
                should_stream: true,
            });
        } else {
            const aiResponse = await TavernHelper.generate({
                injects: [{ role: 'user', content: finalPrompt, position: 'in_chat', depth: 0, should_scan: true }],
                should_stream: false,
            });
            if (typeof aiResponse !== 'string') throw new Error('AI未返回有效的文本响应。');
            await this.handleStreamEnd(aiResponse);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("handleAction 失败:", error);
        this.showTemporaryMessage(`行动失败: ${error.message}. 正在回滚状态。`, 3000);
        this.renderUI(this.currentMvuState);
        this.isBusy = false;
        this.optimisticState = null;
        this.hideWaitingMessage();
    }
},
async handleStreamEnd(finalText) {
  if (!this.isBusy) return;
  this.optimisticState = null;
  if (this.isFormatValidationEnabled && !this.validateResponseFormat(finalText)) {
      this.showCustomConfirm(
          'AI响应格式错误，可能被截断。是否继续处理？',
          async () => {
              this.showTemporaryMessage('正在处理可能不完整的响应...');
              await this.processFinalResponse(finalText);
          },
          async () => {
              this.showTemporaryMessage('行动已取消，状态已回滚。');
              this.isBusy = false;
              this.hideWaitingMessage();
              await this.updateDynamicData(true);
          }
      );
  } else {
      await this.processFinalResponse(finalText);
  }
},
formatActionsForAI(userMessage) {
  let commandText = '';
  if (this.pendingActions.length > 0) {
    commandText += '[本轮行动指令]\n';
    this.pendingActions.forEach(cmd => {
      let actionText = '';
      switch (cmd.action) {
        case 'use': actionText = `使用: ${cmd.itemName} (x${cmd.quantity})`; break;
        case 'discard': actionText = `丢弃: ${cmd.itemName} (x${cmd.quantity})`; break;
        case 'deposit': actionText = `存入: ${cmd.itemName} (x${cmd.quantity})`; break;
        case 'withdraw': actionText = `取出: ${cmd.itemName} (x${cmd.quantity})`; break;
        case 'travel': actionText = `前往: ${cmd.locationName}`; break;
        case 'do_action': actionText = `行动: ${cmd.text}`; break;
        case 'equip': actionText = `装备: ${cmd.itemName}`; break;
        case 'unequip': actionText = `卸下: ${cmd.itemName}`; break;
        case 'equip_from_safehouse': actionText = `从仓库装备: ${cmd.itemName}`; break;
        default: actionText = `未知指令: ${cmd.action}`; break;
      }
      commandText += `- ${actionText}\n`;
    });
  }
  if (userMessage) {
    commandText += `\n<行动内容>\n${userMessage}\n</行动内容>`;
  }
  return commandText;
},
async processFinalResponse(finalText) {
    this.optimisticState = null;
    try {
        const updateScript = this._extractLastTagContent('UpdateVariable', finalText, true);
        let authoritativeState = this.currentMvuState;
        if (updateScript) {
            const inputData = { old_variables: this.currentMvuState };
            try {
                await eventEmit('mag_invoke_mvu', updateScript, inputData);
                if (inputData.new_variables) {
                    authoritativeState = inputData.new_variables;
                } else {
                    throw new Error("MVU插件未返回新变量。");
                }
            } catch (mvuError) {
                console.warn("MVU调用失败，使用前端备用方案进行更新:", mvuError);
                const fallbackState = this._applyUpdateFallback(updateScript, this.currentMvuState);
                if (fallbackState) {
                    authoritativeState = fallbackState;
                }
            }
        }
        // 1. 更新内存中的权威状态
        this.currentMvuState = authoritativeState;

        // 2. 使用内存中的最新状态刷新UI
        this.renderUI(this.currentMvuState);
        await this.loadAndDisplayCurrentScene(finalText);

        // 3. 【核心修复】严格按照代码2的逻辑，精准操作 messages[0]
        const messages = await getChatMessages('0'); // <--- 关键修改点
        if (messages && messages.length > 0) {
            const gameScreenMessage = messages[0];
            
            gameScreenMessage.data = this.currentMvuState;
            gameScreenMessage.message = finalText;

            // 创建一个新的消息数组，只包含这一个更新后的消息
            const messagesToSave = [gameScreenMessage];

            await TavernHelper.setChatMessages(messagesToSave, { refresh: 'none' });
        } else {
            // 如果没有消息历史，则创建一个新的 (此逻辑保持不变，作为备用)
            await TavernHelper.send({
                role: 'assistant',
                content: finalText,
                data: this.currentMvuState,
                is_user: false
            });
        }
        
        // 4. 执行其他后续操作
        await this.performAutoSave();

    } catch(error) {
        console.error("处理最终响应时出错:", error);
        this.showTemporaryMessage(`错误: ${error.message}`);
    } finally {
        this.isBusy = false;
        this.hideWaitingMessage();
    }
},
          formatMessageContent(text) {
    if (!text) return '';
    let formatted = text.replace(/\\n/g, '<br />');
    formatted = formatted.replace(/<center>/g, '<center>').replace(/<\/center>/g, '</center>');

    // 1. 隐藏原始的判定请求文本
    formatted = formatted.replace(/【判定请求\|.*?】/g, (match) => `<span class="roll-request">${match}</span>`);

    // 2. 美化多段式搜索的阶段标题
    formatted = formatted.replace(/【(第一阶段：潜力评估|第二阶段：逐项获取|伤害结算|武器故障检定)】/g, '<strong class="roll-block-title">$1</strong>');
    formatted = formatted.replace(/\[(槽位\d+)\]/g, '<strong class="roll-block-title">$1</strong>');

    // 3. --- 核心修复：采用全新的、更健壮的分步匹配策略 ---
    // 匹配 【判定：...】 紧跟着 [判定结果]【...】 的模式
    const rollBlockRegex = /(【判定：([\s\S]*?)】)\s*([\s\S]*?)(\[判定结果\]【(.*?)】(?:\s*\((.*?)\))?)/g;

    formatted = formatted.replace(rollBlockRegex, (fullMatch, titleBlock, titleContent, detailsContent, resultBlock, outcomeText, outcomeComment) => {
        
        const title = titleContent.trim();
        const details = detailsContent.trim(); // 中间的详细信息

        const extractDetail = (label, content) => {
            const regex = new RegExp(`${label}:(.*?)(?:\\||$)`);
            const match = content.match(regex);
            return match ? match[1].trim() : null;
        };

        const character = extractDetail('角色', details);
        const skill = extractDetail('相关技能', details);
        const modifier = extractDetail('情境修正', details);
        const dc = extractDetail('目标难度\\(DC\\)', details);
        
        const finalResultMatch = details.match(/最终结果:\s*\[(\d+)\]/);
        const finalResult = finalResultMatch ? finalResultMatch[1] : null;

        const targetDifficultyMatch = details.match(/目标难度:\s*\[(\d+)\]/);
        const targetDifficulty = targetDifficultyMatch ? targetDifficultyMatch[1] : dc;

        outcomeText = outcomeText || '未知';
        outcomeComment = outcomeComment || '';

        let outcomeClass = '';
        switch (outcomeText) {
            case '完美成功': outcomeClass = 'roll-perfect'; break;
            case '成功': outcomeClass = 'roll-success'; break;
            case '失败': outcomeClass = 'roll-failure'; break;
            case '灾难性失败': outcomeClass = 'roll-critical-failure'; break;
            default: outcomeClass = '';
        }

        let detailsHtml = '';
        if (character || skill || modifier) {
            detailsHtml = `<div class="roll-details">`;
            if (character) detailsHtml += `<span><strong>角色:</strong> ${character}</span>`;
            if (skill) detailsHtml += `<span><strong>技能:</strong> ${skill}</span>`;
            if (modifier) detailsHtml += `<span><strong>修正:</strong> ${modifier}</span>`;
            detailsHtml += `</div>`;
        }

        let resultTextHtml = '';
        if (finalResult || targetDifficulty) {
            resultTextHtml = `<span>结果: ${finalResult || '??'} / ${targetDifficulty || '??'}</span>`;
        }
        
        let commentHtml = '';
        if (outcomeComment) {
            commentHtml = `<div class="roll-comment">(${outcomeComment})</div>`;
        }

        return `
            <div class="roll-container">
                <div class="roll-title">${title}</div>
                ${detailsHtml}
                <div class="roll-result-wrapper">
                    <div class="roll-result">
                        ${resultTextHtml}
                        <span class="roll-outcome ${outcomeClass}">${outcomeText}</span>
                    </div>
                    ${commentHtml}
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    });

    // 4. 应用原有的其他文本美化
    formatted = formatted.replace(/\*\*\*([^*]+?)\*\*\*/g, (match, p1) => `<span class="game-text-emphasis">${p1}</span>`);
    formatted = formatted.replace(/\*([^*]+?)\*/g, (match, p1) => `<span class="game-text-special-italic">${p1}</span>`);

    return formatted;
},

          handleStreamUpdate(currentText) {
            const gameTextDisplay = document.getElementById('game-text-display');
            if (gameTextDisplay) {
              const displayText = this._getDisplayText(currentText);
              gameTextDisplay.innerHTML = this.formatMessageContent(displayText);
            }
          },
          validateResponseFormat(text) {
            let validationText = text;

            // 【核心修复】使用更智能的方式移除从第一个<thinking>到最后一个</thinking>之间的所有内容
            const firstThinkingOpen = validationText.toLowerCase().indexOf('<thinking>');
            const lastThinkingClose = validationText.toLowerCase().lastIndexOf('</thinking>');

            if (firstThinkingOpen !== -1 && lastThinkingClose > firstThinkingOpen) {
                // 提取出思考块之前和之后的内容，然后拼接起来
                const beforeThinking = validationText.substring(0, firstThinkingOpen);
                const afterThinking = validationText.substring(lastThinkingClose + '</thinking>'.length);
                validationText = beforeThinking + afterThinking;
            }

            const tags = ['gametxt', 'UpdateVariable', '生存日志'];
            for (const tag of tags) {
              const openTag = `<${tag}>`;
              const closeTag = `</${tag}>`;
              const openTagCount = (validationText.match(new RegExp(openTag.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'gi')) || []).length;
              const closeTagCount = (validationText.match(new RegExp(closeTag.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'gi')) || []).length;
              
              if (openTagCount > 0 && openTagCount !== closeTagCount) {
                console.warn(`[IZ] 格式验证失败: 关键标签 <${tag}> 未正确闭合。`);
                return false;
              }
            }
            return true;
          },
          SafeGetValue(obj, path, defaultValue = 'N/A') {
    let value = _.get(obj, path);
    if (value === undefined || value === null) return defaultValue;
    if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 2 && typeof value[1] === 'string') {
        if (Array.isArray(value[0]) && value[0][0] === '$__META_EXTENSIBLE__$') {
            return [];
        }
        return value[0];
    }
    if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
    if (typeof value === 'object') return value;
    return String(value);
},
          async updateDynamicData(isAuthoritative = false) {
  try {

      // 这个分支现在主要用于UI初始化或强制同步

},
async loadAndDisplayCurrentScene(messageContent) {

renderSaveSlot(slotId, defaultName, saveData, nameColor = '') {

      const survivalDays = this.SafeGetValue(statData, '生存天数', '?');
      const location = this.SafeGetValue(statData, '当前位置[0].具体位置', '未知地点');
      const summary = this._getDisplayText(saveData.message_content);
      html += `

      <button class="interaction-btn btn-delete-slot btn-danger" ${!saveData ? 'disabled' : ''}>删除</button>

handleSaveSlotInteraction(event) {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target.disabled) return;
    const slotDiv = target.closest('.save-slot');
    if (!slotDiv) return;
    const slotId = slotDiv.dataset.slotId;
    if (!slotId) return;
    if (target.classList.contains('btn-save-slot')) this.saveGame(slotId);
    else if (target.classList.contains('btn-load-slot')) this.loadGame(slotId);
    else if (target.classList.contains('btn-delete-slot')) this.deleteSave(slotId);
    else if (target.classList.contains('btn-export-slot')) this.exportSave(slotId);
},

getSavesFromStorage() {
  try {
    const saves = localStorage.getItem('survival_multi_save_data');
    return saves ? JSON.parse(saves) : {};
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("获取存档失败:", e);
    return {};
  }
},

async saveGame(slotId) {
  try {
    const allSaves = this.getSavesFromStorage();
    const slotExists = allSaves[slotId];
    const defaultName = slotExists ? allSaves[slotId].save_name : (slotId.startsWith('auto') ? (slotId.endsWith('0') ? '最新自动存档' : '上一个自动存档') : `手动存档 ${slotId.split('_')[1]}`);
    const saveName = await this.promptForSaveName(defaultName);
    if (saveName === null) { this.showTemporaryMessage('保存已取消'); return; }

    const performSave = async () => {
      try {
        // 【核心修复】同样使用 getChatMessages('0') 来精准获取数据载体
        const messages = await getChatMessages('0'); // <--- 关键修改点
        if (!messages || messages.length === 0) {
            throw new Error("无法获取当前消息数据，无法存档。");
        }
        
        const messageToSave = messages[0];
        const currentMvuData = messageToSave.data;
        const currentMessageContent = messageToSave.message || '';

        if (!currentMvuData || !currentMvuData.stat_data) {
          throw new Error('MVU数据不完整或不存在，无法安全保存。请先进行一次游戏交互。');
        }

        const bookName = '隔离区日志';
        const lorebookKeysToSnapshot = ['生存日志', '行动档案', 'NPC动态档案', '动态世界状态'];
        const lorebookData = {};

        try {
          const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
          const entriesToProcess = [];
          
          for (const key of lorebookKeysToSnapshot) {
              const saveEntryName = `${saveName}-${key}`;
              lorebookData[key] = saveEntryName;
              const sourceEntry = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === key);
              const existingSnapshot = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === saveEntryName);
              const contentToSave = sourceEntry ? sourceEntry.content || '' : '';
              
              if (existingSnapshot) {
                  entriesToProcess.push({uid: existingSnapshot.uid, content: contentToSave});
              } else {
                  entriesToProcess.push({
                      comment: saveEntryName,
                      content: contentToSave,
                      keys: [saveEntryName],
                      enabled: false
                  });
              }
          }

          const updates = entriesToProcess.filter(e => e.uid);
          const creates = entriesToProcess.filter(e => !e.uid);
          if (updates.length > 0) await TavernHelper.setLorebookEntries(bookName, updates);
          if (creates.length > 0) await TavernHelper.createLorebookEntries(bookName, creates);

        } catch (e) {
          console.error("创建/更新世界书快照失败:", e);
          this.showTemporaryMessage("警告: 世界书快照失败，但主要数据仍会保存。");
        }

        const saveDataPayload = {
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          save_name: saveName,
          message_content: currentMessageContent,
          lorebook_data: lorebookData,
          mvu_data: {
              stat_data: currentMvuData.stat_data,
              schema: currentMvuData.schema,
              display_data: currentMvuData.display_data,
              delta_data: currentMvuData.delta_data
          }
        };

        allSaves[slotId] = saveDataPayload;
        localStorage.setItem('survival_multi_save_data', JSON.stringify(allSaves));
        this.showTemporaryMessage(`存档 "${saveName}" 已完成。`);
        this.showSaveLoadManager();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('保存失败:', error);
        this.showTemporaryMessage(`保存失败: ${error.message}`);
      }
    };
    if (slotExists) {
      this.showCustomConfirm(`存档位已存在，是否覆盖 "${slotExists.save_name}"?`, performSave, null, true);
    } else {
      await performSave();
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('保存过程中出错:', error);
    this.showTemporaryMessage(`保存失败: ${error.message}`);
  }
},

async loadGame(slotId) {
  const allSaves = this.getSavesFromStorage();
  const saveData = allSaves[slotId];
  if (!saveData) { this.showTemporaryMessage('未找到存档文件。'); return; }
  const saveName = saveData.save_name || `存档 ${slotId.split('_')[1]}`;
  this.showCustomConfirm(`读取存档 "${saveName}"?\n所有未保存的进度将会丢失。`, async () => {
    try {
      this.showWaitingMessage();
      this.updateWaitingMessage('正在读取存档数据...');
      const messages = await getChatMessages();
      if (!messages || messages.length === 0) { throw new Error('无法获取聊天历史以读取存档。'); }
      
      messages[0].data = saveData.mvu_data;
      const lastMessageIndex = messages.length - 1;
      messages[lastMessageIndex].message = saveData.message_content;
      if (messages.length > 1) delete messages[lastMessageIndex].data;

      if (saveData.lorebook_data) {
        const bookName = '隔离区日志';
        try {
          const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
          const entriesToUpdate = [];

          for (const [sourceKey, snapshotKey] of Object.entries(saveData.lorebook_data)) {
              const snapshotEntry = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === snapshotKey);
              const sourceEntry = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === sourceKey);
              if (snapshotEntry && sourceEntry) {
                  entriesToUpdate.push({ uid: sourceEntry.uid, content: snapshotEntry.content || '' });
              }
          }
          if (entriesToUpdate.length > 0) {
              await TavernHelper.setLorebookEntries(bookName, entriesToUpdate);
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("恢复世界书失败:", e);
          this.showTemporaryMessage("警告: 恢复世界书失败，但主要数据已恢复。");
        }
      }
      await TavernHelper.setChatMessages(messages, { refresh: 'all' });
      this.closeAllModals();
      this.showTemporaryMessage(`读取 "${saveName}" 完成！`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('读取失败:', error);
      this.showTemporaryMessage(`读取失败: ${error.message}`);
    } finally {
        this.hideWaitingMessage();
    }
  }, null, true);
},

async deleteSave(slotId) {
  const allSaves = this.getSavesFromStorage();
  const saveData = allSaves[slotId];
  if (!saveData) return;
  const saveName = saveData.save_name || `存档 ${slotId.replace('slot_', '')}`;
  let confirmMessage = `删除存档 "${saveName}"?\n此操作无法撤销。`;
  if (saveData.lorebook_data) {
    confirmMessage += `\n相关的世界书快照也将被删除。`;
  }
  this.showCustomConfirm(confirmMessage, async () => {
    try {
      if (saveData.lorebook_data) {
        const bookName = '隔离区日志';
        const entryNamesToDelete = Object.values(saveData.lorebook_data);
        const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
        const uidsToDelete = allEntries.filter(e => entryNamesToDelete.includes(e.comment)).map(e => e.uid);
        if (uidsToDelete.length > 0) {
          await TavernHelper.deleteLorebookEntries(bookName, uidsToDelete);
        }
      }
      delete allSaves[slotId];
      localStorage.setItem('survival_multi_save_data', JSON.stringify(allSaves));
      this.showTemporaryMessage(`存档 "${saveName}" 已删除。`);
      this.showSaveLoadManager();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('删除存档失败:', error);
      this.showTemporaryMessage(`删除失败: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }, null, true);
},

clearAllSaves() {
  this.showCustomConfirm(`确认清除所有存档？\n这将删除所有手动和自动存档，此操作不可逆！`, async () => {
    try {
      const allSaves = this.getSavesFromStorage();
      const bookName = '隔离区日志';
      const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
      const uidsToDelete = [];
      for(const slotId in allSaves) {
        const saveData = allSaves[slotId];
        if (saveData.lorebook_data) {
          const entryNamesToDelete = Object.values(saveData.lorebook_data);
          const foundUids = allEntries.filter(e => entryNamesToDelete.includes(e.comment)).map(e => e.uid);
          uidsToDelete.push(...foundUids);
        }
      }
      if(uidsToDelete.length > 0) {
        await TavernHelper.deleteLorebookEntries(bookName, _.uniq(uidsToDelete));
      }
      localStorage.removeItem('survival_multi_save_data');
      this.showTemporaryMessage(`所有存档已清除。`);
      this.showSaveLoadManager();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('清除所有存档失败:', error);
      this.showTemporaryMessage(`清除失败: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }, null, true);
},

async promptForSaveName(defaultName = '') {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    this.closeAllModals();

    modal.className = 'modal-overlay';
    modal.style.cssText = 'display: flex; z-index: 2000;';
    modal.innerHTML = `
      <div class="modal-content" style="width: 400px; height: auto;">
        <div class="modal-header"><h2 class="modal-title">存档命名</h2></div>
        <div class="modal-body" style="padding: 20px;">
          <p style="margin-bottom: 15px;">输入存档名称:</p>
          <input type="text" id="save-name-input" value="${defaultName}" style="width: 100%; padding: 10px; background: rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.05); border: 1px solid var(--pip-boy-green-dim); color: var(--pip-boy-green); border-radius: 0; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-family: var(--pip-boy-font);">

            <button id="save-name-confirm" class="interaction-btn primary-btn">确认</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    document.querySelector('.survival-root-container').appendChild(modal);
    const input = modal.querySelector('#save-name-input');
    const confirmBtn = modal.querySelector('#save-name-confirm');
    const cancelBtn = modal.querySelector('#save-name-cancel');
    const cleanup = () => {
        modal.remove();
        this.showSaveLoadManager();
    };
    confirmBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const saveName = input.value.trim();
      if (!saveName) { this.showTemporaryMessage('请输入存档名称'); return; }
      cleanup();
      resolve(saveName);
    });
    cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { cleanup(); resolve(null); });
    input.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') confirmBtn.click(); });
    setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 100);
  });
},

async performAutoSave() {
  if(!this.isAutoSaveEnabled) return;
  try {
    const allSaves = this.getSavesFromStorage();
    
    // 轮换旧的自动存档
    const latestSave = allSaves['auto_save_slot_0'];
    if (latestSave) {
      allSaves['auto_save_slot_1'] = {...latestSave, save_name: '上一个自动存档'};
    }

    // --- 核心修复：统一数据来源为 messages[0] ---
    const messages = await getChatMessages('0');
    if (!messages || messages.length === 0) {
        console.error('[IZ] 自动存档失败：无法获取数据载体 message[0]。');
        return;
    }
    const messageToSave = messages[0];
    const currentMvuData = messageToSave.data;
    const currentMessageContent = messageToSave.message || '';
    
    if (!currentMvuData || !currentMvuData.stat_data) {
        console.error('[IZ] 自动存档失败：message[0] 中的MVU数据不完整。');
        return;
    }
    // --- 修复结束 ---

    const bookName = '隔离区日志';
    const lorebookKeysToSnapshot = ['生存日志', '行动档案'];
    const autoSaveLorebookData = {};
    const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
    const entriesToUpdateOrCreate = [];

    for (const key of lorebookKeysToSnapshot) {
        const saveEntryName = `自动存档-最新-${key}`;
        autoSaveLorebookData[key] = saveEntryName;
        const sourceEntry = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === key);
        const existingSnapshot = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === saveEntryName);
        const content = sourceEntry ? sourceEntry.content || '' : '';
        if (existingSnapshot) {
            // 为避免API调用失败，只在内容不同时才更新
            if(existingSnapshot.content !== content) {
                entriesToUpdateOrCreate.push({ uid: existingSnapshot.uid, content: content });
            }
        } else {
            entriesToUpdateOrCreate.push({ comment: saveEntryName, content: content, keys: [], enabled: false });
        }
    }

    const updates = entriesToUpdateOrCreate.filter(e => e.uid);
    const creates = entriesToUpdateOrCreate.filter(e => !e.uid);
    if (updates.length > 0) await TavernHelper.setLorebookEntries(bookName, updates);
    if (creates.length > 0) await TavernHelper.createLorebookEntries(bookName, creates);

    const newSaveData = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      save_name: '最新自动存档',
      message_content: currentMessageContent,
      lorebook_data: autoSaveLorebookData,
      mvu_data: { // 确保保存完整的数据结构
          stat_data: currentMvuData.stat_data,
          schema: currentMvuData.schema,
          display_data: currentMvuData.display_data,
          delta_data: currentMvuData.delta_data
      }
    };
    allSaves['auto_save_slot_0'] = newSaveData;
    localStorage.setItem('survival_multi_save_data', JSON.stringify(allSaves));
    this.showTemporaryMessage('自动存档完成', 1500);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[IZ] 自动存档失败:', error);
    // 向用户显示一个更明确的错误信息
    this.showTemporaryMessage(`自动存档失败: ${error.message}`, 3000);
  }
},

async exportSave(slotId) {
  this.showTemporaryMessage('准备导出...', 2000);
  try {
    const allSaves = this.getSavesFromStorage();
    const saveData = allSaves[slotId];
    if (!saveData) throw new Error('存档数据未找到。');
    const exportData = {
      exportVersion: '1.2-survival-pipboy',
      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      saveData: saveData,
      lorebookSnapshot: {}
    };
    if (saveData.lorebook_data) {
      const bookName = '隔离区日志';
      const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
      for (const key in saveData.lorebook_data) {
          const snapshotName = saveData.lorebook_data[key];
          const entry = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === snapshotName);
          if (entry) {
              exportData.lorebookSnapshot[snapshotName] = entry.content;
          }
      }
    }
    const jsonString = JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([jsonString], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    const safeSaveName = (saveData.save_name || slotId).replace(/[^a-z0-9_\-]/gi, '_');
    a.download = `IZ_Save_${safeSaveName}.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    this.showTemporaryMessage('存档导出成功！');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('导出存档时出错:', error);
    this.showTemporaryMessage(`导出失败: ${error.message}`);
  }
},

async handleFileImport(event) {
  const file = event.target.files[0];
  if (!file) return;
  this.showTemporaryMessage('正在导入存档...', 3000);
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = async (e) => {
    try {
      const importData = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      if (!importData.exportVersion?.startsWith('1.') || !importData.saveData) {
        throw new Error('无效或不兼容的存档文件格式。');
      }
      const allSaves = this.getSavesFromStorage();
      let emptySlotId = null;
      for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
        const slotId = `slot_${i}`;
        if (!allSaves[slotId]) { emptySlotId = slotId; break; }
      }
      if (!emptySlotId) { throw new Error('没有可用的空手动存档位。'); }
      
      const newSaveData = importData.saveData;
      newSaveData.save_name = `${newSaveData.save_name || '导入的存档'} (导入)`;
      
      if(importData.lorebookSnapshot) {
        const bookName = '隔离区日志';
        const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
        const entriesToCreate = [];

        for (const snapshotName in importData.lorebookSnapshot) {
            const content = importData.lorebookSnapshot[snapshotName];
            const existingEntry = allEntries.find(e => e.comment === snapshotName);
            if (!existingEntry) {
                entriesToCreate.push({ comment: snapshotName, content: content, keys: [snapshotName], enabled: false });
            }
        }
        if (entriesToCreate.length > 0) {
            await TavernHelper.createLorebookEntries(bookName, entriesToCreate);
        }
      }
      allSaves[emptySlotId] = newSaveData;
      localStorage.setItem('survival_multi_save_data', JSON.stringify(allSaves));
      this.showTemporaryMessage(`存档已导入至存档位 ${emptySlotId.split('_')[1]}！`);
      this.showSaveLoadManager();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('导入存档时出错:', error);
      this.showTemporaryMessage(`导入失败: ${error.message}`);
    } finally {
      event.target.value = '';
    }
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
},
          async showMap() {

              const mapEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === mapEntryKey);
              if (!mapEntry || !mapEntry.content) {
                throw new Error(`在世界设定"${bookName}"中未找到或内容为空的条目"${mapEntryKey}"。`);
              }
              const locations = this.parseMapData(mapEntry.content);
              const stat_data = (this.optimisticState || this.currentMvuState)?.stat_data;
              const playerCoords = this.SafeGetValue(stat_data, '当前位置.坐标', null);

            }
          },
          parseMapData(content) {
            if (!content || typeof content !== 'string') return [];
            const locations = [];
            const lines = content.trim().split('\n');
            lines.forEach(line => {
              if (!line.startsWith('[') || !line.endsWith(']')) return;
              const parts = line.substring(1, line.length - 1).split('|');
              if (parts.length < 3) return;
              const locationData = { name: parts[0].trim() };
              for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) {
                const [key, ...valueParts] = parts[i].split(':');
                const value = valueParts.join(':').trim();
                if (key && value) {
                  locationData[key.trim()] = value;
                }
              }
              if (locationData.x && locationData.y) {
                locations.push(locationData);
              }
            });
            return locations;
          },
          renderMap(container, locations, playerCoords = null) {
            if (!container) return;
            container.innerHTML = '';
            const mapContainer = document.createElement('div');
            mapContainer.className = 'map-container';
            const SCALE_FACTOR = 10;
            locations.forEach(loc => {
              const dot = document.createElement('div');
              dot.className = 'map-location-dot';
              dot.dataset.type = loc.type || 'Unknown';
              const x = parseFloat(loc.x) / SCALE_FACTOR, y = parseFloat(loc.y) / SCALE_FACTOR;
              const w = parseFloat(loc.w || loc.width || 30);
              const h = parseFloat(loc.h || loc.height || 30);
              if (isNaN(x) || isNaN(y)) return;
              dot.style.cssText = `left: ${x}px; top: ${y}px; width: ${w}px; height: ${h}px;`;
              dot.textContent = loc.name;
              dot.title = `${loc.name}\n类型: ${loc.type || 'N/A'}\n状态: ${loc.state || '正常'}`;
              dot.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                this.showCustomConfirm(`设定路线前往 [${loc.name}]?`, () => this.addTravelAction(loc), null, true);
              });
              mapContainer.appendChild(dot);
            });
            if (playerCoords && playerCoords.x !== undefined && playerCoords.y !== undefined) {
              const cursor = document.createElement('div');
              cursor.className = 'player-cursor';
              const playerX = parseFloat(playerCoords.x) / SCALE_FACTOR, playerY = parseFloat(playerCoords.y) / SCALE_FACTOR;
              if (!isNaN(playerX) && !isNaN(playerY)) {
                cursor.style.cssText = `left: ${playerX}px; top: ${playerY}px;`;
                cursor.title = `你的位置 (x:${playerX * SCALE_FACTOR}, y:${playerY * SCALE_FACTOR})`;
                mapContainer.appendChild(cursor);
                this.mapState.playerMapPos = { x: playerX, y: playerY };
              }
            } else { this.mapState.playerMapPos = null; }
            container.appendChild(mapContainer);
            document.getElementById('btn-center-player').disabled = !this.mapState.playerMapPos;
            this.updateMapTransform();
            this.updateZoomSliderUI();
          },
          bindMapEvents(container) {
            container.addEventListener('wheel', this.handleMapWheel.bind(this), { passive: false });
            container.addEventListener('mousedown', this.handleMapMouseDown.bind(this));
            container.addEventListener('mousemove', this.handleMapMouseMove.bind(this));
            window.addEventListener('mouseup', this.handleMapMouseUp.bind(this));
            container.addEventListener('mouseleave', this.handleMapMouseUp.bind(this));
            document.getElementById('zoom-slider')?.addEventListener('input', this.handleZoomSlider.bind(this));
            document.getElementById('btn-center-player')?.addEventListener('click', this.centerOnPlayer.bind(this));
          },
          updateMapTransform() {
            const mapContainer = document.querySelector('#map-modal-body .map-container');
            if (mapContainer) {
              mapContainer.style.transform = `translate(${this.mapState.panX}px, ${this.mapState.panY}px) scale(${this.mapState.scale})`;
            }
          },
          resetMapState() {
            this.mapState = { scale: 1, panX: 0, panY: 0, isPanning: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, animationFrameId: null, playerMapPos: this.mapState.playerMapPos };
            this.updateMapTransform();
            this.updateZoomSliderUI();
          },
          handleMapWheel(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            const scaleAmount = this.mapState.scale * 0.1;
            const containerRect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
            const mouseX = event.clientX - containerRect.left;
            const mouseY = event.clientY - containerRect.top;
            const oldScale = this.mapState.scale;
            const newScale = event.deltaY > 0 ? Math.max(0.1, oldScale - scaleAmount) : Math.min(5, oldScale + scaleAmount);
            this.mapState.panX = mouseX - (mouseX - this.mapState.panX) * (newScale / oldScale);
            this.mapState.panY = mouseY - (mouseY - this.mapState.panY) * (newScale / oldScale);
            this.mapState.scale = newScale;
            this.updateMapTransform();
            this.updateZoomSliderUI();
          },
          handleMapMouseDown(event) {
            if(event.button !== 0) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            this.mapState.isPanning = true;
            this.mapState.startX = event.clientX - this.mapState.panX;
            this.mapState.startY = event.clientY - this.mapState.panY;
          },
          handleMapMouseMove(event) {
            this.updateCursorCoords(event);
            if (this.mapState.isPanning) {
              event.preventDefault();
              if (!this.mapState.animationFrameId) {
                this.mapState.animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                  this.mapState.panX = event.clientX - this.mapState.startX;
                  this.mapState.panY = event.clientY - this.mapState.startY;
                  this.updateMapTransform();
                  this.mapState.animationFrameId = null;
                });
              }
            }
          },
          handleMapMouseUp(event) {
            this.mapState.isPanning = false;
            if (this.mapState.animationFrameId) {
              cancelAnimationFrame(this.mapState.animationFrameId);
              this.mapState.animationFrameId = null;
            }
          },
          updateZoomSliderUI() {
            const slider = document.getElementById('zoom-slider');
            const display = document.getElementById('zoom-level-display');
            if (slider && display) {
              slider.value = this.mapState.scale;
              display.textContent = `${Math.round(this.mapState.scale * 100)}%`;
            }
          },
          handleZoomSlider(event) {
            const newScale = parseFloat(event.target.value);
            if (!isNaN(newScale)) {
              const container = document.querySelector('#map-modal-body');
              const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
              const centerX = containerRect.width / 2;
              const centerY = containerRect.height / 2;
              const oldScale = this.mapState.scale;
              this.mapState.panX = centerX - (centerX - this.mapState.panX) * (newScale / oldScale);
              this.mapState.panY = centerY - (centerY - this.mapState.panY) * (newScale / oldScale);
              this.mapState.scale = newScale;
              this.updateMapTransform();
              this.updateZoomSliderUI();
            }
          },
          updateCursorCoords(event) {
            const display = document.getElementById('cursor-coords-display');

            const container = document.querySelector('#map-modal-body');

            const mouseX = event.clientX - containerRect.left;
            const mouseY = event.clientY - containerRect.top;
            const mapMouseX = (mouseX - this.mapState.panX) / this.mapState.scale;
            const mapMouseY = (mouseY - this.mapState.panY) / this.mapState.scale;
            const SCALE_FACTOR = 10;
            display.textContent = `x: ${Math.round(mapMouseX * SCALE_FACTOR)}, y: ${Math.round(mapMouseY * SCALE_FACTOR)}`;

          centerOnPlayer() {
            if (!this.mapState.playerMapPos) {

            const container = document.querySelector('#map-modal-body');
            const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();

          async handleMapUpdateCommand(commandContent) {
            this.showTemporaryMessage('正在更新地图数据...', 1500);
            try {
              const bookName = '隔离区日志';
              const mapEntryKey = '地图';
              const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
              const mapEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === mapEntryKey);
              if (!mapEntry) throw new Error("地图条目未找到。");
              let currentLocations = this.parseMapData(mapEntry.content || '');
              let modified = false;
              const updates = this.parseMapData(this._extractLastTagContent('更新', commandContent) || '');
              updates.forEach(update => {
                const index = currentLocations.findIndex(loc => loc.name === update.name);
                if (index !== -1) {
                  Object.assign(currentLocations[index], update);
                  modified = true;
                }
              });
              const newLocations = this.parseMapData(this._extractLastTagContent('新增', commandContent) || '');
              newLocations.forEach(newLoc => {
                if (newLoc.name && !currentLocations.some(loc => loc.name === newLoc.name)) {
                  currentLocations.push(newLoc);
                  modified = true;
                }
              });
              const deleteContent = this._extractLastTagContent('删除', commandContent);
              if(deleteContent) {
                  const namesToDelete = deleteContent.replace(/[\[\]]/g, '').split(',').map(name => name.trim());
                  const initialLength = currentLocations.length;
                  currentLocations = currentLocations.filter(loc => !namesToDelete.includes(loc.name));
                  if (currentLocations.length < initialLength) modified = true;
              }
              if (modified) {
                const newContent = currentLocations.map(loc => {
                  const parts = [`${loc.name}`];
                  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(loc)) {
                    if (key !== 'name') {
                      parts.push(`${key}:${value}`);
                    }
                  }
                  return `[${parts.join('|')}]`;
                }).join('\n');

              const fields = ['事件概要', '叙事脉络记录', '伏笔', '标签'];
              let html = '<span style="font-size: 12px;">要修剪的字段:</span>';

          bindLogListeners() {
            const modalBody = document.getElementById('history-modal-body');
            if (!modalBody || modalBody.dataset.listenerAttached === 'true') return;
            modalBody.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
              const target = e.target;
              if (target.id === 'btn-precise-trim') this.handlePreciseTrim();
              else if (target.id === 'btn-auto-trim') this.handleAutoTrim();
              else if (target.id === 'btn-full-trim') this.handleFullTrim();
              else if (target.classList.contains('trim-field-checkbox')) this.saveTrimFieldsState();
            });
            modalBody.dataset.listenerAttached = 'true';
          },
          reconstructLogEntry(entries) {
            if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return '';
            const fieldOrder = ['编号', '日期', '地点', '行动代号', '事件概要', '标签', '叙事脉络记录', '伏笔'];
            return entries.map(entry => {
              return fieldOrder
                .map(key => (entry[key] ? `${key}|${String(entry[key]).trim()}` : null))
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join('\n');
            }).join('\n\n');
          },

          async _executeTrim(mode) {
              const keepCount = (mode === 'auto-trim' || mode === 'full-trim') ? parseInt(document.getElementById('trim-keep-count').value, 10) : null;
              const checkedBoxes = mode === 'precise-trim' ? document.querySelectorAll('#history-modal-body .log-trim-checkbox:checked') : null;
              const sequenceIdsToTrim = mode === 'precise-trim' ? Array.from(checkedBoxes).map(box => box.dataset.sequenceId) : null;
              const fieldsToRemove = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.trim-field-checkbox:checked')).map(cb => cb.value);
              const narrativePointsToRemove = document.getElementById('trim-narrative-points')?.value.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

              if (mode === 'precise-trim' && checkedBoxes.length === 0) {
                  this.showTemporaryMessage('请先在下方日志中勾选需要修剪的条目。'); return;
              }
              if ((mode === 'precise-trim' || mode === 'auto-trim') && fieldsToRemove.length === 0 && (!narrativePointsToRemove || narrativePointsToRemove.length === 0)) {
                  this.showTemporaryMessage('请勾选要修剪的字段或输入要修剪的叙事点ID。'); return;
              }
              if (isNaN(keepCount) && (mode === 'auto-trim' || mode === 'full-trim')) {
                  this.showTemporaryMessage('请输入有效的保留条目数量。'); return;
              }

              const confirmMsg = mode === 'full-trim' ? `[危险] 确认永久删除除最新 ${keepCount} 条外的所有日志？` : `确认执行修剪操作？`;

              this.showCustomConfirm(confirmMsg, async () => {
                  this.showTemporaryMessage('正在修剪...');
                  try {
                      const bookName = '隔离区日志', logKey = '生存日志';
                      const allEntries = await TavernHelper.getLorebookEntries(bookName);
                      const logEntry = allEntries.find(entry => entry.comment === logKey);
                      if (!logEntry || !logEntry.content) throw new Error('日志内容未找到。');

                      let events = this.parseLogEntry(logEntry.content);
                      let trimCount = 0;

                      if (mode === 'full-trim') {
                          if (events.length > keepCount) {
                              trimCount = events.length - keepCount;
                              events = events.slice(events.length - keepCount);
                          }
                      } else {
                          const originalEventCount = events.length;
                          events.forEach((event, index) => {
                              const isTarget = (mode === 'precise-trim' && sequenceIdsToTrim.includes(event['编号'])) ||
                                             (mode === 'auto-trim' && index < originalEventCount - keepCount);

                              if (isTarget) {
                                  let hasTrimmedThisEvent = false;
                                  fieldsToRemove.forEach(field => {
                                      if (event.hasOwnProperty(field)) {
                                          delete event[field];
                                          hasTrimmedThisEvent = true;
                                      }
                                  });

                                  if (narrativePointsToRemove.length > 0 && event['叙事脉络记录']) {
                                      let narrativeLines = event['叙事脉络记录'].split('\n');
                                      const originalLineCount = narrativeLines.length;
                                      narrativeLines = narrativeLines.filter(line => {
                                          const match = line.match(/^\s*(\d+)\./);
                                          return !match || !narrativePointsToRemove.includes(match[1]);
                                      });

                                      if (narrativeLines.length < originalLineCount) {
                                          event['叙事脉络记录'] = narrativeLines.join('\n');
                                          if (!event['叙事脉络记录'].trim()) delete event['叙事脉络记录'];
                                          hasTrimmedThisEvent = true;
                                      }
                                  }
                                  if (hasTrimmedThisEvent) trimCount++;
                              }
                          });
                      }

                      if (trimCount === 0) {
                          this.showTemporaryMessage('没有内容被修剪。'); return;
                      }

                      const newContent = this.reconstructLogEntry(events);
                      await TavernHelper.setLorebookEntries(bookName, [{ uid: logEntry.uid, content: newContent }]);
                      this.showTemporaryMessage(`修剪完成！处理了 ${trimCount} 个条目。`, 3000);
                      this.showSurvivalLog();

                  } catch (error) {
                      console.error('修剪日志时出错:', error);
                      this.showTemporaryMessage(`修剪失败: ${error.message}`, 3000);
                  }
              }, null, true);
          },

          saveTrimFieldsState() {
